title: Create movie manually
intro: Use this form when the movie is not on TMDB. It registers a title in the MovieMux catalog, not in a collection.
titleHint: Enter at least one title. All other fields are optional.
genresUnavailable: Genres could not be loaded. They are optional.
saved: Movie registered in the MovieMux catalog. To add it to a collection, open that collection and search for it.
invalid: Check the fields: at least one title is required; titles and director allow 150 characters, synopsis 4,000, runtime 1–999 and up to 32 genres.
uncertain: Could not confirm registration. You can retry the exact same request without creating a second movie.
conflict: This request conflicts with an earlier registration. Check the catalog before creating another movie.
leaveHint: It may already have been saved. Leaving discards this retry option. Check the catalog before registering the movie again.
proofError: Catalog access could not be verified.
environment: Manual registration needs a secure connection. Reopen MovieMux over HTTPS.
